schema.description: ResourceQuotaStatus defines the enforced hard limits and observed use.

hard.description: Hard is the set of enforced hard limits for each named resource. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/policy/resource-quotas/

used.description: Used is the current observed total usage of the resource in the namespace.

description:
Subject: Current Resource Quota Status for the Namespace  

The namespace is configured with hard limits of 4 CPU cores, 8 GiB of memory, and a maximum of 10 pods. As of the latest metrics collection, actual usage stands at 2 CPU cores, 3 GiB of memory, and 4 pods in total. These figures indicate that we are comfortably within the allocated quotas, with roughly half of the CPU and memory limits still available and ample capacity for additional pods. Please let me know if you anticipate any upcoming workloads that might approach these limits so we can plan accordingly.
